title: FROZEN PREREG -- ENTRY QUALITY LEDGER + structure-presence admissibility battery (LANE 4, Thu 2026-08-06 evening)
commit_discipline: This file is committed via commit_scoped.py BEFORE the ledger builder or any battery runner exists (git-provable freeze order). If any definition below is edited after the runner exists, this prereg is VOID and must be re-registered.
sibling_prereg_not_superseded: analysis/recommendations/entry-structure-forward-prereg-2026-08-06.json (V-d1 + V-e3 forward shadow protocol) stays in force unchanged. Tonight's shadow-counter SHIP implements ITS measurement protocol; nothing here re-tunes its cells or gates.

population.entries: every option BUY fill in automation/state/fills-ledger.jsonl with attribution=='engine' (activity_id-deduped). One buy FILL = one entry event; multi-fill orders disclosed, not merged.
population.pnl: FIFO within (arm, symbol, date_et) over ALL fills regardless of attribution -- exits are broker truth even when a manual/EOD-flatten sell closed an engine entry. Unclosed remainders (expiry) would carry pnl = -cost; as of freeze there are none (0 unmatched sell qty, 0 leftover, verified).
population.v1_delta_disclosed: The 08-05 study's LIVE-ENGINE-REAL-FILLS-v1 (n=230, net +$317 <=08-05) silently EXCLUDED one engine entry whose exit was manual-attributed: 2026-06-26 safe-2 SPY260626P00732000 3x @0.98 -> manual sell @0.19 = -$237. v2 includes it. True <=08-05 net = +$80. v2 also extends through 2026-08-06.
population.mfe_authority: analysis/pain-ledger/mae-mfe.json (frozen entry+1 conventions), joined per (arm, symbol, entry bar-minute). Entry events that are ADDS to an open position have no pain-ledger row: mfe=null, counted and disclosed, never zero-filled.

ledger_factors_frozen.note: Factors (a)-(f) are DESCRIPTIVE ledger columns computed at entry time ONLY (C6: every bar used must have CLOSED at or before the entry fill timestamp). No significance claims attach to descriptive crossings; only the admissibility cells below get the permutation + BH treatment.
ledger_factors_frozen.a_structure: market_structure.analyze_structure over closed RTH bars strictly before entry. 5m read: window=3, quorum 8 closed 5m bars (below quorum = BLIND). 1m read: window=5, quorum 20 closed 1m bars. Recorded: last-event kind/direction/bars_ago per timeframe, plus derived buckets AGREES / DISAGREES / NO_EVENT / BLIND (direction-agreement vs trade side; identical definitions to the 08-05 study for reconciliation).
ledger_factors_frozen.b_level_tied: ENTER decision's trigger_level (fleet rows) / trigger_level_exact or *_level_raw (core rows) non-null == LEVEL-TIED; null == BARE confirmation. Attribution from the arm's own decisions ledger row for that symbol+date; unmatched = unattributed, disclosed.
ledger_factors_frozen.c_extreme_distance: signed distance from entry spot (last closed 1m close) to the nearest same-session extreme (session high for calls / session low for puts, computed over closed 1m bars) THAT IS ALSO PRESENT in the engine's own levels_active (core-decisions.jsonl timeline, causally latest row <= entry ts; match tolerance $0.25). Sign: +ve = extreme is AHEAD of the trade direction (buying toward supply / selling toward demand). levels_active exists only from 2026-07-28 -> earlier entries ABSTAIN, disclosed.
ledger_factors_frozen.d_last5_dir: V-d1 factor: last fully closed 5m bar direction vs trade side (up/down/flat; agreement = close>open for calls, close<open for puts). Identical to the frozen V-d1 rule input.
ledger_factors_frozen.f_vwap_side: entry spot vs session VWAP computed causally over closed RTH 1m bars (cum sum typical*vol / cum vol, RTH-anchored). above/below/unknown.

admissibility_cells_frozen.blocking_semantics: A cell BLOCKS an entry (counterfactual: entry never taken, its realized FIFO P&L removed) or ABSTAINS (insufficient data = entry stands; abstain never blocks). Delta = -(sum of blocked P&L) = dollars the rule would have added.
admissibility_cells_frozen.direction_agnostic_by_design: Cells test PRESENCE of structure, not agreement -- frozen on the 08-05 finding that the DISAGREES bucket was the most profitable cohort and NO_EVENT was the killer. A direction-agreement gate is explicitly NOT a candidate.

cells.rule: block if >=8 closed 5m RTH bars exist AND analyze_structure(window=3) reports NO BOS/CHoCH at all (last_event is None). Abstain below quorum.
cells.provenance: V-e1 shape from the 08-05 study (post-hoc there; this is its first registration on v2).

cells.rule: block if >=8 closed 5m RTH bars exist AND there is NO BOS/CHoCH whose break_index falls within the LAST 8 closed 5m bars (no event at all, or last event older than 8 bars). Abstain below quorum.
cells.provenance: THE lane-4 named rule: 'require ANY structure event within 8 bars'. Thu 10:31 exemplar had BOS DOWN 5 bars prior (passes); Wed 09:58-10:19 cohort had zero events (blocks).

cells.rule: block if >=20 closed 1m RTH bars exist AND analyze_structure(window=5) reports NO BOS/CHoCH at all. Abstain below quorum.
cells.provenance: V-e3 re-scored on v2 + 08-06 (its own forward prereg stays authoritative for its forward gates).

cells.rule: block if >=20 closed 1m RTH bars exist AND there is NO BOS/CHoCH whose break_index falls within the LAST 40 closed 1m bars. Abstain below quorum.
cells.provenance: 1m recency analogue of R-S8-5m (8 x 5m = 40 min). Registered so the timeframe choice is not cherry-picked after the fact.

cells.rule: block if last fully closed 5m bar closed AGAINST the trade direction (close<=open for calls, close>=open for puts... strictly: dir != required dir; flat blocks). Abstain if no closed 5m bar.
cells.provenance: frozen in b9cd7a6e + entry-structure-forward-prereg-2026-08-06.json; re-scored on v2 ONLY to baseline the shadow counter. Its forward verdict ladder lives in ITS prereg, not here.

per_cell_stats: delta_ex_best_day (drop the cell's single best day)
battery_frozen.permutation: within-day permutation, 20,000 draws, seed 20260806: hold each day's NUMBER of blocked entries fixed, randomize WHICH entries within that day are blocked, one-sided p = fraction of draws with permuted delta >= observed delta. This is the discriminating test (picked-the-bad-ENTRY vs sat-out-a-bad-DAY).
battery_frozen.bh_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg across ALL 5 cells' permutation p-values (this battery is the family; nothing dropped, all cells reported). Significance bar: q <= 0.10.

gates.G7: BH q <= 0.10 on the within-day permutation

verdict_ladder.FORWARD_SHADOW_CANDIDATE: G1..G6 pass (G7 informative): eligible for the frozen forward-shadow prereg set, NEVER armed tonight.
verdict_ladder.WATCH: G1+G2 pass, any of G3..G6 fail.

battery_frozen.selection_rule_precommitted: AT MOST TWO cells graduate to FROZEN forward-shadow preregs tonight: the best-scoring 5m cell and the best-scoring 1m cell by (gates passed, then delta_drop_top2), each only if it reaches FORWARD_SHADOW_CANDIDATE. V-d1 does not consume a slot (already frozen forward). If zero qualify, zero graduate and that is the reported outcome. NOTHING IS ARMED TONIGHT under any outcome -- J's standing paper bias (take the trade) + the entry-filter graveyard make arming a forward-evidence decision only.

shadow_counter_ship.what: setup/scripts/entry_shadow_counter.py -- nightly, measurement-only: for each engine entry fill of the day, compute would_block booleans for V-d1 + V-e3 (per entry-structure-forward-prereg-2026-08-06.json measurement_protocol) + the graduated cells above (diagnostic), tally to analysis/entry-quality/shadow-tally.jsonl (per-entry rows, idempotent per activity_id) + analysis/entry-quality/shadow-summary.json.
shadow_counter_ship.trading_path_impact: ZERO. Reads ledgers + SIP bars after the close; never blocks, never writes any engine/params surface. Guards + RED-proof + one-line revert + REVOKE entry in STATUS.md.
shadow_counter_ship.forward_gates_authority: entry-structure-forward-prereg-2026-08-06.json F1-F5 (10-session window) -- this ship is the instrument that makes those gates measurable without a human.

kill_criteria_precommitted: If R-S8-5m fails G1 or G2 on v2, the 'require a structure event within 8 bars' idea is REJECTED on this population and goes to the graveyard list with its numbers -- no re-cutting to rescue it.

If the NO_EVENT bucket reconciliation fails (v2 bucket does not reproduce the 08-05 study's sign and rough magnitude on the shared <=08-05 window), the discrepancy is REPORTED as the finding and no cell may graduate tonight.
what_would_falsify: If blocked-cohort WR is indistinguishable from population WR forward, the rules select nothing and every in-sample dollar was day-level exposure reduction (the falsification already frozen in the forward prereg).
